label: preparing
what: A coordinated, private bread-supply/grain arrangement was being worked out, apparently to address the innkeeper's urgent grain need and the builder/freight request for nineteen bales. Builder and freight offered planks/services; the baker was arranging bread supplies privately and received planks from builder. The record supports joint preparation/arrangement, but does not establish that the grain purchase was completed or that the vague bakery bridge/port-change rumor was real. The mayor was not told of the arrangement before the evidence of it; later the mayor learned of it from the neighbour.
